- 60–80m: data residency/security & compliance Q/A (Neha will lead)
- 80–90m: mutual action items and next steps

- Wed 6/19 10:30–12:00 PT
- Thu 6/20 14:00–15:30 PT
- Fri 6/21 09:00–10:30 PT
